alien-space-battle-manual.evidence: Explicitly labelled UNOFFICIAL EDITED RULES REFERENCE PDF for named BGG8046 LouZocchi AlienSpaceBattleManual,not an original publisher-rulebook facsimile. The34-page PDF identifies fifth printingApril1979,copyright1973LouZocchi,editedTonyVanLiew2001. It combines typeset shared rules with scans of all eight original ship hit records and special-weapon sheets (Dort,Earthship,Kuzi,Repazoid,Rojun,Rux,Zark,Zeron),ship counters,templates and weapon-interaction chart. Identity matches the named eight-alien-ship/string-aiming freeform game; related licensedStarFleet BattleManual is not substituted. Core setup,energy/movement/shields/aiming/hit/life-support and ending procedures were read; editorial additions/omissions are explicit. Native shared-rule pages2-13 are retained; scanned appendix pages14-34 use freshEnglishOCR, including the mostly absent native layer on page23. All eight ship-record/weapon pairs and final template/cross-index coverage were checked; Dort weapon sheet and full cross-index were visually read. Not every individual special-weapon interaction was independently audited. The transcriber adds vector-movement and special-weapon/fighter material,comments on altitude, and intentionally replaces the original campaign rules with advice to use another campaign game. These changes are not attributed to Zocchi or certified as original1973/1979 rules. Accepted as a usable,clearly scoped fan reference for the core game with original ship supplements, not a complete original printed manual/campaign recovery or publisher endorsement. Scan/OCR has spelling,numeric and chart-layout errors; original PDF images govern scanned appendices. String lengths/counter/template scales require original physical components or independent scale checks; a complete printable playable set is not certified. No summary QA/PASS or source-backed error verdict awarded.
